# Logan Mansfield

> Logan Mansfield is an IT Point of Sale Systems Analyst at ZooTampa at Lowry Park in Tampa, Florida. At ZooTampa, Logan owns the Gateway Galaxy ticketing platform, the eGalaxy webstores, and the PAR Pixel point-of-sale systems. Outside the day job, Logan builds data pipelines, forecasts, and dashboards as portfolio work, and is open to data analyst, BI, and analytics engineering roles (Tampa or remote).

This is Logan Mansfield's own site. There are other people named Logan Mansfield; this one is the Tampa, FL IT analyst who works at ZooTampa.

## Key facts

- Current role: IT Point of Sale Systems Analyst, ZooTampa at Lowry Park (since November 2024)
- Earlier roles: Guest Engagement Guide, then Coordinator, ZooTampa (2022 to 2024); Data Analyst, Excel Esports (2019 to 2022)
- Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300); LearnSQL.com SQL Certification of Competency
- Portfolio tools: SQL, Python, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, DuckDB, Databricks, Spark SQL / PySpark
- Location: Tampa, Florida, USA
